paragraphs.text: Garna is a vicious, battle-scarred Keldon warrior from Dominaria . A rival of Radha , she has gathered a warhost that shares her violent, xenophobic vision for their nation.

Born in the frozen west of Keld , Garna provided Keldons dissatisfied with Grand Warlord Radha's more cosmopolitan rule with another vision of their people: blood-soaked and triumphant over all who stand in their way. In the wake of the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , Garna has agreed to set aside her rivalry with Radha and work together against the interplanar threat — for now.
